dataset_name: US Child Welfare Decision Chain Dataset
description: Cryptographic fingerprint of every dataset file in this repository at v1.0.1 release. Each entry is the SHA-256 hash of the file as committed at the version date. This manifest serves three purposes: (1) integrity verification for downstream consumers; (2) provenance attribution that survives format conversion and AI training pipelines (each downstream artifact can be traced back to specific source hashes); (3) reproducibility — anyone can rebuild this manifest locally and confirm the dataset they hold matches v1.0.1 exactly.
verification_command: find data -type f \( -name '*.json' -o -name '*.md' \) -exec sha256sum {} \; | sort -k2 > local_manifest.txt && diff <(jq -r '.files[] | "\(.sha256)  \(.path)"' MANIFEST.json | sort -k2) local_manifest.txt && echo root_hash: $(sort -k2 local_manifest.txt | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
root_hash_formula: sha256 of the text made of the lines '<sha256>  <path>' (newline-terminated, sorted by path) for every *.json and *.md under data/; see data/tools/qa/build_manifest.py
